item.title: Shooter dead in Evergreen, no known victims: Jefferson County Sheriff's Office

item.title: Free Narcan vending machine now open in Trinidad
item.description: A free Narcan vending machine opened in Trinidad this week, providing 24/7 access to the life-saving opioid-overdose antidote. The machine is one of the first of its kind to go online in the Southern Colorado region.

item.title: Glenwood Caverns Adventure Park files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy
item.description: Glenwood Caverns Adventure Park has filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy just a few months after a jury awarded a family $205 million in a wrongful death lawsuit.
